statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial was based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
